brief_summary: The study is to treat metformin dose-escalation diabetic subjects of all stages of renal failure (stages 1-5) and compare their rates of erythrocyte metformin (best reflections of a possible accumulation than those of plasma) to the therapeutic range. A number of 12 patients by stage is considered, 60 patients in total.
brief_title: May Metformin be Used in Renal Failure?
conditions: Renal Disorder Associated With Type II Diabetes Mellitus
official_title: May Metformin be Used in Renal Failure?

primary_outcomes.measure: the percentage of patients in each category of renal function whose rate of erythrocyte metformin remain within the therapeutic range, at each stage of treatment.
